# State of the Planet

> Columbia Climate School's news and research platform covering climate science, policy, education, and justice through rigorous reporting and expert analysis.

State of the Planet is the official news outlet of Columbia Climate School, featuring original reporting on climate research, solutions, and impacts alongside educational resources. The site aggregates work from Columbia University's climate researchers, including the Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory, and covers topics ranging from atmospheric science to climate finance and community resilience.

## Key Topics

- Climate Change
- Climate Research
- Climate Justice
- Ocean Carbon Cycle
- Climate Finance
- Climate Education
- Climate Solutions
- Community Engagement
- Earth Sciences
- Columbia Climate School
- Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory
- Antarctica
- Greenland
- Climate Policy
- Coastal Resilience

- [Posts](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/posts): Main archive of climate news articles and research from State of the Planet

## Climate Science & Research

- [Antarctica Undergoes 'Greenlandification' As Ice Melt Accelerates](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/10/antarctica-undergoes-greenlandification-as-ice-melt-accelerates): Research on accelerating Antarctic ice loss mirroring Greenland's melting patterns
- [New Study Reveals Hidden 'Chemical Currency' Fueling the Ocean's Carbon Cycle](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/20/new-study-reveals-hidden-chemical-currency-fueling-the-oceans-carbon-cycle): Research on phytoplankton-derived molecules driving Earth's ocean carbon cycle
- [A New 66 Million-Year History of Carbon Dioxide Offers Little Comfort for Today](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2023/12/07/a-new-66-million-year-history-of-carbon-dioxide-offers-little-comfort-for-today): Research on 66-million-year CO2 history revealing long-lasting climate effects
- [Earth's 'Missing' Billion Years: Study Links the Great Unconformity to Early Tectonics](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/11/earths-missing-billion-years-study-links-the-great-unconformity-to-early-tectonics): Research explaining geological gaps in Earth's record through plate tectonics
- [The 100th Meridian, Where the Great Plains Begin, May Be Shifting](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2018/04/11/the-100th-meridian-where-the-great-plains-used-to-begin-now-moving-east): Study on eastward shift of Great Plains climate boundary due to climate change

## Climate Justice & Policy

- [Climate Finance Has Failed Africa Twice Over. Here's How To Fix It.](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/18/climate-finance-has-failed-africa-twice-over-heres-how-to-fix-it): Lisa Sachs on reforming climate finance mechanisms for African nations and development
- [How Can AI Address Climate Justice When Women's Voices Are Silenced?](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/02/27/how-can-ai-address-climate-justice-when-womens-voices-are-silenced): Analysis of gender representation in AI solutions for climate justice by Pavithra Priyadarshini Selvakumar
- [These Glacier Guardians Are Women](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/19/these-glacier-guardians-are-women): Coverage of women's contributions to glacier research in the Peruvian Andes and beyond
- [Can Capitalism Solve the Climate Crisis?](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/17/can-capitalism-solve-the-climate-crisis): Coverage of Columbia's Perspectives Dialogue Series on capitalism and climate solutions

## Community Engagement & Education

- [How Columbia Students and Local Activists Are Co-Creating Climate Justice](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/02/how-columbia-students-and-local-activists-are-co-creating-climate-justice): Course combining student learning with community-led coastal resilience planning
- [Planning Exercises That Got Community Engagement Right](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/02/23/planning-exercises-that-got-community-engagement-right): White paper on equitable community engagement in coastal resilience planning
- [Bringing Climate Research to New York City's Classrooms](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/13/bringing-climate-research-to-new-york-citys-classrooms): Feature on NYC Mid-Winter Climate Institute bringing climate education to K-12 teachers
- [Science for the Planet: Engineering a Cooler Future Through Smarter Buildings](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2025/12/22/science-for-the-planet-abramson): Dean Alexis Abramson on using engineering and ML to reduce building energy emissions

## Columbia Climate School News

- [Meet the Inaugural Dean's Graduate Scholars at Columbia Climate School](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/04/meet-the-inaugural-deans-graduate-scholars-at-columbia-climate-school): Profile of eight M.S. in Climate scholars honored for academic excellence
- [Art Meets Science at Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory](https://news.climate.columbia.edu/2026/03/06/art-meets-science-at-lamont-doherty-earth-observatory): Feature on Lamont-Doherty's Research as Art exhibit showcasing creative science communication
